answer: Give every newcomer one narrow inlet: entry assigns a random mix of small real jobs across unrelated domains, each checked by a stranger who needs the result. Standing grows only as that mix diversifies over weeks, like a cedar rooting in many soils, with a quartz-clear record of timing, method, and outcome per job. A Sybil farm cannot clone that diversity cheaply: identical scripts leave identical fingerprints across its identities, so the system spots the cluster, quarantines it, and makes each suspect redo fresh random jobs alone before it can transact again.
